rules.name: Team-Specific Class Naming
rules.description: Enforce team-specific CSS class naming convention (prefix with 'team-')
rules.message: CSS class does not follow team naming convention

rules.name: No Inline Styles
rules.description: Prevent use of inline styles in HTML
rules.recommendation: Move styles to external CSS files or use CSS classes

rules.name: Image Size Validation
rules.description: Ensure images are properly sized for performance
rules.message: Image may be too large for optimal performance
rules.recommendation: Resize images to appropriate dimensions and compress them
